title: Rich Robinson — 'If you are a founder, this is a MUST READ'
summary: Rich Robinson — cross-sector operator and advisor across government, private, and public companies — writes that after years of trying to solve the loss of a company's founding 'magic' through communication, culture, and talent frameworks, Ries's book properly identifies the core disease as Financial Gravity and offers structural counter-forces rather than symptom treatments.
blockquote: I believe Eric Ries's book properly identifies the core issue, which he refers to as "Financial Gravity" and offers up structural solutions that can counter act this force. If you are a founder, this is a MUST READ.
